 DAYTON, Ohio (WKEF) -- With Medicare open enrollment underway, many people may be wondering how to choose the right plan.
 Good Day Dayton stopped by Medicare Planning of Dayton to learn how the family-run business helps clients compare options, understand changes, and get support year-round.
